title: NIGHT SHIFT 2004 — E2E
question: PROJECT TITLE NIGHT SHIFT 2004 — E2E  CREATIVE BRIEF Develop two independent premium trailer concepts from this idea for a young-adult audience. ChatGPT and Claude will each receive the same brief through Raycast.  Create an original fictional streaming-series concept for viewers 18–28, set during a chaotic 2004 electronic-music festival weekend. Two estranged friends discover that a disposable camera contains photographs of a crime that has not happened yet. Ground it in friendship, identity, nightlife, music, consequences, and a sharp plot twist. Premium realistic tone; no existing IP, real people, logos, or instructional drug detail.  DELIVERY - Exactly one open-ended, high-paced 12-second Sora sizzler prompt per model - The writing, imagery, action, sound, music, rhythm, and title impact are one integrated video prompt - World-building may be slightly futuristic, fantasy, period, or pre-AI 2000s when it serves the concept - Prioritize an immediate hook, emotional discovery, and a sharp plot-turn payoff - Include intentional audio, music, ambience, dialogue, and SFX direction inside the prompt - Do not return a shot list, multiple prompt options, or claim a video was generated - No visual reference supplied.  RAYCAST WORKFLOW Run “Start Directors Cut Concept Run.” Enter the project title as argument 1 and leave argument 2 blank to use this copied brief. The command saves the project, rebuilds the Projects index, and copies the canonical prompt for ChatGPT; capture ChatGPT, then repeat with Claude.
